P3B-A-EVAL-NU-DIVISOR_PAIR_SUM-01:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=1 TILL i<=n, i++) { IF (n%i==0) { NUMBER term=i*i+1. total+=term. } }
DISPLAYNL(total).
P3B-A-EVAL-NU-ODD_STEP_RECURRENCE-01:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER x=1.
LOOP (NUMBER i=1 TILL i<=n, i++) { IF (i%2==0) { x=2*x-i. } ELSE { x=2*x+i. } }
DISPLAYNL(x).
P3B-A-EVAL-AR-EXTREMA_SPREAD-01:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER hi=values[0].
NUMBER lo=values[0].
LOOP (NUMBER i=1 TILL i<4, i++) { IF (values[i]>hi) { hi=values[i]. } IF (values[i]<lo) { lo=values[i]. } }
DISPLAYNL(hi-lo+1).
P3B-A-EVAL-AR-PAIR_PRODUCT_GAP-01:
